title: Staff Channel is a separate ingress, not a new payment authority
summary: Staff-coordinated Core payments use a separate Queue Fabric ingress bound to authenticated Staff Channel and exact Staff Authority evidence. This prevents an ordinary customer channel from fabricating STAFF-looking fields and reaching the staff payment path.
invariants: Authenticated Staff Channel cannot use the ordinary customer payment ingress as a substitute for its own perimeter.
A staff payment command carries exact Staff Authority envelope/action provenance and is rejected before Ledger if that binding is missing.
Core Payments still performs Security Effect, Institutional Policy and Legal Effect.
Ledger remains the only monetary authority; Staff Channel is transport/coordination authority.

provenance.claim: Separate authenticated Staff Channel payment ingress and exact Staff Authority evidence.
